title: Structure of the human Ccr4-Not nuclease module using X-ray crystallography and electron paramagnetic resonance spectroscopy distance measurements.
authors: Zhang, Qionglin; Pavanello, Lorenzo; Potapov, Alexey; Bartlam, Mark; Winkler, Gerlof Sebastiaan
journal: Protein science : a publication of the Protein Society
one_liner_zh: 该文用X射线晶体学、AlphaFold预测和EPR光谱确定人Ccr4-Not核酸酶模块中EEP结构域位置，虽涉及蛋白复合物结构建模，但对象为RNA脱腺苷酶复合物而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且方法以实验结构测定为主，与TF-DNA结合机制课题关联较弱。
abstract: Regulated degradation of mature, cytoplasmic mRNA is a key step in eukaryotic gene regulation. This process is typically initiated by the recruitment of deadenylase enzymes by cis-acting elements in the 3' untranslated region resulting in the shortening and removal of the 3' poly(A) tail of the target mRNA. The Ccr4-Not complex, a major eukaryotic deadenylase, contains two exoribonuclease subunits with selectivity toward poly(A): Caf1 and Ccr4. The Caf1 deadenylase subunit binds the MIF4G domain of the large subunit CNOT1 (Not1) that is the scaffold of the complex. The Ccr4 nuclease is connected to the complex via its leucine-rich repeat (LRR) domain, which binds Caf1, whereas the catalytic activity of Ccr4 is provided by its EEP domain. While the relative positions of the MIF4G domain of CNOT1, the Caf1 subunit, and the LRR domain of Ccr4 are clearly defined in current models, the position of the EEP nuclease domain of Ccr4 is ambiguous. Here, we use X-ray crystallography, the AlphaFold resource of predicted protein structures, and pulse electron paramagnetic resonance spectroscopy to determine and validate the position of the EEP nuclease domain of Ccr4 resulting in an improved model of the human Ccr4-Not nuclease module.
abstract_zh: 成熟细胞质mRNA的调控性降解是 eukaryotic 基因调控中的关键步骤。此过程通常由3'非翻译区中的顺式作用元件招募 deadenylase 酶启动，导致目标mRNA的3' poly(A)尾缩短并移除。Ccr4-Not复合物，一种主要的 eukaryotic deadenylase，包含两个对poly(A)具有选择性的外切核糖核酸酶亚基：Caf1和Ccr4。Caf1 deadenylase亚基结合大亚基CNOT1（Not1）的MIF4G结构域，该大亚基是复合物的支架。Ccr4核酸酶通过其富含亮氨酸重复序列（LRR）结构域连接到复合物，该结构域结合Caf1，而Ccr4的催化活性由其EEP结构域提供。尽管当前模型中CNOT1的MIF4G结构域、Caf1亚基和Ccr4的LRR结构域的相对位置已明确，但Ccr4的EEP核酸酶结构域的位置仍不明确。在此，我们使用X射线晶体学、AlphaFold预测蛋白质结构资源以及脉冲电子顺磁共振光谱学来确定并验证Ccr4的EEP核酸酶结构域的位置，从而改进人类Ccr4-Not核酸酶模块的模型。
